stories.title: Como funciona a Lei Seca nas eleições 2026

en.title: How the Electoral Dry Law works in 2026 elections
en.summary: Brazil's Electoral Dry Law restricts alcohol sales and consumption during voting periods, with rules varying by location in 2026 elections. Six states have territory-wide prohibitions while four others have regulations defined by electoral zones, with local authorities determining specific restrictions.
